Sideload AsperaConnect-0.3.2.apk

On the PC:
  cd ~/Downloads
  curl -L -o AsperaConnect-0.3.2.apk \
    "https://github.com/ramchandragada/asperaconnect/raw/cursor/phone-contacts-sync-5b4f/dist/release/AsperaConnect-0.3.2.apk"

  # USB debugging on:
  adb uninstall com.asperaconnect.companion
  adb install -r AsperaConnect-0.3.2.apk

Or copy the APK to the phone and open it. App bottom must show v0.3.2.
